text:
The dish is a shallow bowl or plate, roughly 24 cm across. It holds about 8 half-slices of zucchini and a small pile of sautéed mushrooms, about 20 pieces.

Zucchini: roughly 4 slices' worth, about 60 g, at around 10 kcal.

Mushrooms: small whole button mushrooms, about 20 at 7 g each, which is around 140 g. Cooked with oil they come to roughly 40 kcal per 100 g plus the oil, so about 60 kcal plus about 50 kcal of oil, or about 110 kcal.

Total: about 200 g of food and about 120 kcal.
